newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late SIR20 rubber flat in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late SIR20 rubber flat in slow trading.

text.p: Indonesian benchmark tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were flat in late trading on Wednesday despite fresh U.S. enquiries in Padang and Palembang, dealers said.

"There are some fresh enquiries from the U.S. for SIR20 fob Padang and Palembang. We expect deals to be done later today, but prices are likely to remain mostly unchanged," one dealer in Jakarta said.

Dealers said SIR20 offer prices for November/December deliveries were at 54.75-55.25 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan and at 54.25-55.00 cents fob Palembang, Surabaya and Padang, and at 54.25-54.50 cents fob Jambi and Pontianak.
Dealers said SIR20 was last sold at 54.25 cents/lb fob Padang late on Tuesday for December deliveries to the United States.
One Bandung-based latex dealer said October deliveries high amoniac grade latex was sold at 2,200 rupiah/kg against 2,230 for September deliveries in the local markets.
Another Bandung-based dealer said RSS1 for October deliveries was last sold at 3,108 rupiah/kg in the local markets against 3,093 rupiah previously.
